label: D1 after an a1 choice, moderate a1 lean, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2), on about 6% of D1 steps. Almost all mass (78%, plus 18% where the previous action is outside the window) follows a trial where the agent chose a1; after a2 it is nearly silent (rate 0.002). Active steps have a moderately positive policy logit at D1 (a1 favoured, choice in 2.8..8; never negative or saturated) and a middling value (7.1..7.7). It fires mostly in the first half of the episode (rate falls steadily with ep_trial, near zero after trial 80). Magnitude is largest when the previous a1 trial was unrewarded (prev_reward 0 holds 81% of mass; covers 79% of the top quartile vs 24% of the bottom). No future variable is needed. Precision stays low (about 0.26): within this context the feature fires sparsely, so the predicate describes where it can fire, not exactly when. Best F1 about 0.38 on dev.
